title: Representative-level intrinsic site Hom transport
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a finite commutative ring. Let R be the exact constant-scalar associated-module-sheaf realization. For cochain complexes L_c and I_c of fixed-scalar pro-etale module sheaves, with I_c K-injective, the realization of the fixed-scalar derived internal Hom of Q(L_c) and Q(I_c) is isomorphic to the intrinsic constant-ring derived internal Hom of their realized derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem intrinsicSiteHom_transport_representatives (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (Lc Ic : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))) ℤ)
    [Ic.IsKInjective] :
    Nonempty
      ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization X A).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) X).obj
            (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Lc))).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Ic)) ≅
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{u + 1, u, u} (ProEt.topology X)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X A)).obj
          (op ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization X A).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Lc)),
            (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicRealization X A).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Ic)))
